name: default_chat_loop
summary: ReAct-style default workflow with dynamic tool injection.
notes: The agent selects only the most relevant tools for the current message.

name: grounded_current_info
summary: Time-sensitive requests gather live evidence through tools or a web-enabled model before answering.
notes: Broad live-search requests may route directly to a web-enabled model; structured workflows still prefer local tools.

name: web_model_grounding
summary: Broad current-info questions can route directly to the configured web-enabled model.
notes: Used only when the request does not clearly require structured local workflows such as paper, digest, or article flows.

name: feishu_paper_template
summary: Feishu `/paper ...` command that forces a one-shot `paper_search` flow.
notes: The template rewrites the request to reduce tool-argument trial and error.

name: wechat_article_flow
summary: Evidence-driven WeChat article assistance with article-role stages from planning to final polish.
notes: The workflow returns direct output from `wechat_article_assist` when possible, but the article bundle now also exposes planner/researcher/drafter/critic/editor role stages.

name: scheduled_job_flow
summary: Run a saved prompt on a schedule and push the result proactively.
notes: The scheduler routes the saved message through the normal agent loop.

name: heartbeat_checklist
summary: Run a protected HEARTBEAT.md checklist and notify only when action is needed.
notes: Heartbeat uses the normal agent loop, but suppresses proactive output when the result is HEARTBEAT_OK.
